name: quillmark-js
description: The JS tier downstream of the @quillmark/wasm artifact.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/quiver -w packages/svelte && npm run build -w packages/quillkit -w packages/playground -w packages/studio
scripts.site: node packages/quillkit/dist/bin/quillkit.js site --quiver fixtures --out packages/studio/site --client packages/studio/dist
scripts.gate: npm run lint && npm run check && npm run check:canon && npm run check:style && npm run check:deps && npm run build && npm test
